_README: Config for reward-guard.sh on the Mac. While the Reward Vault has NO active timer, any process whose executable path is under blockPaths (or whose name is in blockProcessNames) is killed, unless spared by allowPaths/allowProcessNames. Any active reward timer (all 3 tiers) unlocks everything. Only games are killed - the network is never touched. Paths may start with ~ (expands to your home). After editing, restart the agent: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.rewardvault.guard
_blockPaths_note: Steam games folder (Steam.app lives in /Applications and is NOT here, so the client stays open), plus XIV on Mac's app bundle and data dir so the Wine-run FFXIV process is caught wherever it execs from. Add other game folders if needed.
_blockProcessNames_note: Killed by name wherever installed (matched on the process basename, lowercased). Covers the XIV on Mac launcher and the FFXIV game however Wine names it.
_allowPaths_note: Productivity 'games' to keep runnable even with no timer. Replace the co-op placeholder with the real folder name (must match the folder under steamapps/common exactly).
